title: Sentinel-2 L2A STAC-GeoParquet Mirror
description: An item index for the AWS Earth Search Sentinel-2 L2A archive (51.25 million items when Earth Search was counted on 2026-09-15), published as partitioned STAC-GeoParquet plus MGRS-tile aggregate stats. The record starts in November 2016, when Earth Search's first L2A Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs were produced; 2015 and most of 2016 have no COG products, and 2017-2018 are partial, which is what Earth Search serves. The imagery stays on AWS in the sentinel-cogs bucket; every Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF URL is carried verbatim in each item's `assets` column, so nothing has to be derived from a template. No STAC API sits in front of it: query the Parquet files directly. A second index, `sentinel-2-c1-l2a` with its own `stats-c1`, mirrors Earth Search's Sentinel-2 Collection 1 collection (ESA's reprocessing of the archive) the same way; its backfill is in progress. This is a mirror; Earth Search / Element 84 produces the item indexes this catalog republishes. Read the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) before you query it.
